fields.subject: ArgentSeaRemindersProviderBuilder
fields.trigger: Orleans resolves the keyed Silo provider registered under category "Reminders" for provider name "ArgentSea"
fields.response: add a ClusterOptions options registration to the silo's services and install the ArgentSea reminder service onto the silo builder with ReminderOptions left at their defaults
fields.postcondition: a silo configured only by naming the ArgentSea reminders provider has its reminder service, reminder table, and reminder-options validator registered with ReminderOptions left at their defaults, with no further ReminderOptions configuration required to complete registration

sources.label: IServiceCollection overload registering AddReminders, IReminderTable and IConfigurationValidator
